name: lw_45998
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0 ∧ a + b + c = 3) : Real.sqrt ((a + b) / (a + 1)) + Real.sqrt ((b + c) / (b + 1)) + Real.sqrt ((a + c) / (a + 1)) ≥ 9 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0 ∧ a + b + c = 3), Real.sqrt ((a + b) / (a + 1)) + Real.sqrt ((b + c) / (b + 1)) + Real.sqrt ((a + c) / (a + 1)) ≥ 9 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
informal: Let $a,b,c$ be positive real numbers such that $a+b+c=3$ . Prove that $ \sqrt{\frac{a+b}{a+1}}+\sqrt{\frac{b+c}{b+1}}+\sqrt{\frac{c+a}{c+1}}\ge\frac{9}{a^2+b^2+c^2}$
